integrity: Proof supplies analytic all-parameter classification and exact fixed-input second-order coefficient; deterministic numerical tests are supplementary, not an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean quadratic fidelity and real finite dimension n>=2 only; no statement for arbitrary norms or Banach-fidelity prox. Positive endpoint mechanisms are classical. A stronger unindexed theorem may imply the classification; independent historical-priority verification remains open.
title: Exact time-additivity classification and signed defect for Euclidean \(\ell_p\) proximal maps
